errors.stt_timeout: The speech server did not answer within {{details}}. Check that it is running, or try a faster server.
errors.stt_invalid_key: Speech endpoint rejected the API key. Check the key in Settings.

errors.stt_no_speech_detected: No speech detected. Please try again.
errors.output_fallback_clipboard: Text output failed. The result was copied to clipboard instead. {{details}}
errors.output_wayland_unsupported: Direct typing is unavailable in this Wayland session. The result was copied to the clipboard.

errors.output_streaming_partial: Streaming insert stopped early. The inserted text was kept. {{details}}
errors.llm_failed: AI polishing failed. The original text was output instead. {{details}}

errors.output_wayland_clipboard_copy_only: Copied to clipboard. Paste manually on Wayland.
errors.mic_fallback_default: Your selected microphone "{{details}}" is not connected, so the system default was used.
errors.stt_unreachable: Could not reach the speech server ({{details}}). Check the address in Settings → Speech and that the server is running.

home.subtitle: Press a shortcut anywhere, speak, and polished text is typed for you.

welcome.intro: Welcome to Typelite. Press a shortcut, speak, and polished text lands wherever you type. First, allow the three things Typelite needs.

permissions.microphoneDesc: Hear your voice while you hold or tap a shortcut.
permissions.accessibilityDesc: Global shortcuts and typing into other apps.
permissions.automationDesc: Control System Events to paste and to see which app is in front.

microphone.intro: Pick the microphone Typelite should use. Speak and watch the meter move.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.hint: Click the field, then press the keys you want to use.

dictation.intro: Dictate turns speech into clean text in the app you are using.
dictation.practice: Press {{key}}, say a sentence, then press {{key}} again. The text appears below.
dictation.practiceHold: Hold {{key}}, say a sentence, then let go. The text appears below.

translate.practice: Press {{key}}, say a sentence, then press {{key}} again. The translation appears below.
translate.practiceHold: Hold {{key}}, say a sentence, then let go. The translation appears below.

ask.intro: Ask anything answers a spoken question.
ask.practice: Press {{key}}, ask a question out loud, then press {{key}} again.

appModeDescriptions.social: Social apps like X and LinkedIn.
